claim: Of [4iii] Whether working or relaxing, he always has a scowl on his face: “Example [iii] belongs to the exhaustive conditional construction discussed in Ch. 11, §5.3.5.”
evidence_summary: Ch. 11, §5.3.5 (p. 985) is “Infinitival interrogatives”. §5.3.6, on the same page, is “Interrogatives as adjunct: the ungoverned exhaustive conditional construction”.
inference: Does the cited section treat exhaustive conditionals?
